2. After dashboard + registration: `git commit -m wip(migration-humanitarian-update-2026): dashboard + viz wireup`

4. After QA script + smoke marker: `git commit -m wip(migration-humanitarian-update-2026): qa + smoke`
5. After `npm run deploy` passes: final `feat(post): migration-humanitarian-update-2026` (or amend last wip only if still local-only)

Keep tool batches tight (few reads/writes per turn). Prefer shipping a complete post over endless research.

```
$env:BLOG_REPO_ROOT=E:\AI Projects\data-insights-blog
```

```
npx tsx E:\AI Projects\data-insights-blog/scripts/update-agent-job.mjs --job job-mt254spl-xvz9f --status failed --error short reason --activity Failed
```

- Sources hint: 
- Headline hint: YoY or vintage delta

Firebase Hosting is OUT of the production chain.

1. `src/data/{topic}-data.ts`
2. Dashboard under `src/components/visualizations/`
3. Register visualization in `src/types/post.ts` + `PostVisualization.tsx`

6. `scripts/qa-migration-humanitarian-update-2026.mjs` + smoke-test marker
7. Update `SLUG_THEME_IDS` in theme-registry if needed
8. Record hero in `artifacts/backend-manifest.json`

## Ship gate (local only)
1. Before QA, set isolated ports (mandatory ???????? parallel workers collide on 4173 otherwise):
   ```
   $env:SMOKE_PORT='4188'
   $env:SMOKE_QA_PORT='4189'
   ```
   Then `npm run deploy` exits 0. Each worker owns its own Node static-server ports.
2. `out/blog/migration-humanitarian-update-2026/index.html` or `out/blog/migration-humanitarian-update-2026.html` exists
3. `git add -A` and commit with message: `feat(post): migration-humanitarian-update-2026`
4. Mark job `--status ready` with headline stat
5. Print: `WorkerReady: migration-humanitarian-update-2026 | job=job-mt254spl-xvz9f | worker=5`
6. Exit cleanly (do not start another post)

## Quality blockers
- >=1200 words, >=6 H2s, caveats, table, >=2 internal links
- >=3 chart types, >=4 panels, >=2 controls; no KPI+bar template clone
